entities.summary: Helene Lange (1848–1930) was leading voice for German women's access to higher education and professional careers, particularly in teaching. She helped encourage the establishment of the Frauenbewegung, or women's movement, in Germany and her life's work was to raise the standards of education among women. She believed that social progress was impossible without equal educational opportunities being given to women.
